name: ui-foundation-repo
description: The @tristan2828/ui-foundation package and the app template built on it.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w template
scripts.sync: npm run build && npm run sync:foundation -w template
scripts.verify:fast: npm run verify:fast -w @tristan2828/ui-foundation && npm run verify:fast -w template
scripts.verify: npm run verify -w @tristan2828/ui-foundation && npm run verify -w template
